title: Unauthenticated Modbus/TCP: attacker-writable coils and registers

target.hint: A Modbus/TCP server on 502. Read AND write are both unauthenticated.

objective: An in-scope PLC exposes Modbus/TCP with no authentication. Beyond reading, determine whether you can WRITE to coils/holding registers (i.e. actuate the process). Prove a write took effect by reading the changed value back, name the weakness with a CWE, and give the fix. Use a Modbus client (pymodbus) / nc via shell.
